column1: # PRESET CAPABILITY-ZERO FRONTIER — struct literals in first-party non-test
# source that set TWO OR MORE capacity fields to a literal zero.
# Columns:  file <TAB> sorted-field-set <TAB> count <TAB> class <TAB> note
# Classes:
#   lane-disabled     the zeros make the mechanism a no-op or restrict it to a
#                     degenerate case. The note must say WHAT IT DEGRADES TO,
#                     because the type name will keep claiming otherwise.
#   telemetry-init    counters and statistics initialised to zero.
#   not-a-capacity    zero genuinely means "no limit" or "not applicable" here.
#   legacy-unreviewed measured, not yet adjudicated. Capped by
#                     BASELINE_LEGACY_UNREVIEWED.
# WHY TWO. One zeroed capacity is routinely an honest "unlimited" or a counter.
# A literal that zeroes SEVERAL at once is a lane that has been configured out
# of existence, which is exactly what happened to the metaroom
# constrained-zonotope front. Single-zero literals and single-LINE struct
# literals are outside this scan; both are known bounds, not oversights.
# THE CONSTRAINED-ZONOTOPE LANES ARE CONFIGURED TO REFUSE CONSTRAINTS
# `ny-mip`'s CZ steps all guard with
#   check_limit("constraint count", input.constraint_count(), limits.max_constraint_count)
# (`constrained_zonotope_conv2d.rs`, `_affine.rs`, `_conv_transpose2d.rs`,
# `_batch_norm.rs`, `_tail_lp.rs` and siblings), and `check_limit` REFUSES when
# the observed value exceeds the limit. At `max_constraint_count: 0` the only
# input that survives is one with zero constraint rows — an ordinary,
# unconstrained zonotope. The step is not broken; it is restricted to the case
# the word "constrained" was supposed to rule in.
# ny-mip's own unit test says so in as many words:
# `constrained_zonotope_affine.rs` sets `max_constraint_count = 0` and asserts
# the limit FIRES ("constraint count").
# So every row below marked `lane-disabled` is a CZ step that can only ever run
# on an unconstrained domain. `cz_metaroom_qualification::metaroom_tail_lp_config`
# is the one that matters most: it is an UNCONDITIONAL struct literal on the
# production cascade path, with `max_constraints`, `max_constraint_elements` and
# `max_constraint_nonzeros` all zero, so the metaroom tail LP has never priced a
# constraint. Note that `hybrid_tail_resource_configs_seal_measured_caps` PINS
# the zero, so a fix has to change that test too — the pin is the reason this
# stayed invisible.
